name: Pool Walking

instructions.description: Enter a pool area of suitable depth using safe access.
Walk forward through the water with an upright posture.
Let the arms assist balance and propulsion.
Slow down before turning or leaving the pool.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Pool Walking — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use a supervised pool environment appropriate to swimming ability.
